sections.heading: Mandatory Proving Ingredients & Essential Elements
sections.body: 1. Establish the firm or transaction. 2. Identify the statutory trigger. 3. Prove each constituent fact. 4. Test exceptions and defences. 5. Identify the statutory consequence.

sections.heading: Evidentiary Burdens under BSA 2023 (ss. 104–106 & s. 63)
sections.body: The asserting party ordinarily bears the initial burden on essential facts, subject to admissions and statutory presumptions. Electronic records should be authenticated under the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023.

sections.heading: Procedural Roadmap, Competent Forum & Limitation Act Checkpoints
sections.body: Check jurisdiction, limitation, registration requirements, court fees and the exact relief sought.
